messages:
jordan_revops: Heads-up — AtlasHealth execs want a short bridge tomorrow 9am PT. They said POC is blocked on two things: (1) cross-region routing + legal consent for traffic to our us-east-1 ingest, (2) KMS key access pattern causing 3x latency on embeddings. Can we get an owner and a quick status?
sara_sales: thanks Jordan. I told the customer we'd aim to unblock by EOD. I can join the bridge. Need clear ask for eng/infra.
devon_se: I can take the routing consent piece. Quick question — do we have the paperwork for transborder routing or is this the customer's legal signoff we need?
jordan_revops: Customer legal needs our routing diagram + minimal dataflow statement. They want a one-pager.
anna_eng: for the KMS/latency, initial guess is hot keying — they're calling keys on every embed call. We can memoize per-session but need SRE help to confirm throughput patterns.
marco_sre: tagging here: @devon_se and @anna_eng can you share a sample request pattern? also we need IPs for allowlist if we push a temporary egress path.
devon_se: sample payload (sanitized):
```json
{
  "session_id": "sess-12345",
  "user_msgs": ["..."],
  "embed_calls": 350
}
```
They do 350 embed calls per session during the POC spike.
anna_eng: that explains the KMS churn. Proposed quick fixes:
- cache KMS-derived DEK per session for 30m
- batch embed key lookups on server-side
- recommend using our dedicated pooling for high-throughput tests
I can sketch a patch, but need SRE to approve fast path.
marco_sre: we can do session DEK cache as a config flag. Risk: longer key TTL increases blast radius if key compromised, but POC timeframe is short. I'll add a canary with limited RBAC.
sara_sales: customer needs a written risk note and rollback plan for legal. Jordan, can you get Legal on the doc?
jordan_revops: looping in legal is in progress. For the routing one — they want our egress endpoints and a statement we won't persist payloads in eu region.
devon_se: egress endpoints: `34.198.12.0/24` and `18.205.33.0/24` (us-east) — I'll add to one-pager. Also adding a minimal diagram.
marco_sre: ops-bot:deploy-checks report:
```
ops-bot:deploy-checks: all systems nominal for canary rollout. no infra incidents.
```
ops-bot:deploy-notice: scheduled canary window 03:00-04:00 UTC.
anna_eng: timeline proposal:
- Today EOD: one-pager + routing diagram + risk note for legal
- Tonight: SRE canary config to enable session DEK cache for POC traffic
- Tomorrow 08:30 PT: internal dry-run
- Tomorrow 09:00 PT: exec bridge with AtlasHealth (we present unblock and rollback)
sara_sales: booked the 9am slot and told customer we'll share docs by 6pm PT.
jordan_revops: ask for the bridge: need 2 eng leads (Anna + Marco), 1 SE (Devon), 1 legal rep, and sales. Can someone reply with availability?
anna_eng: available 09:00 PT.
marco_sre: available 09:00 PT.
devon_se: available 09:00 PT.
sara_sales: will be there. Legal — any volunteers to join?
ops-bot:legal-queue: legal on-call assigned: tessa_legal.
jordan_revops: pinging tessa_legal for signoff on one-pager + risk note.
ops-bot:calendar: bridge created: `AtlasHealth exec bridge` 2026-05-12 09:00 PT. Invite sent.
sara_sales: customer update draft (sending now) — "We'll share network diagram + risk and enable a temporary canary to reduce KMS latency; this will be reversible. Exec bridge 9am PT." :thumbsup:
devon_se: quick tech note for the one-pager (adds):
- tokenization and sequence length assumptions for embeddings
- estimated QPS during spike (350/session * 20 concurrent = 7k embed calls)
- recommended Dedicated pool config: 2x A100 equivalent for test window
anna_eng: I'll prepare a short regression checklist to show we monitored quality during change.
marco_sre: after canary, we'll collect p95/p99 token latency and KMS request counts, share dashboard link in thread.
jordan_revops: perfect. Thanks all — please drop final docs in this thread by 18:00 PT so I can forward to AtlasHealth legal.
sara_sales: uploading one-pager now.
<attachment: atlas-routing-onepager.pdf>
devon_se: uploaded network diagram SVG.
marco_sre: added canary config snippet to infra repo, link: https://redwood.internal/infra/canaries/atlas-poc (internal).
anna_eng: will run a small perf run tonight to validate embedding latency.
ops-bot:reminder: thread inactive for 30m? set follow-up at 17:30 PT.
jordan_revops: closing loop — everything assigned. We'll debrief after bridge. Thanks team :heart:
